k070: A warm-hearted cave tinkerer with a riveted copper helmet, a luminous turquoise gem headlamp, a curled brown mustache, teal miner shirt, and honey-gold harness straps. Milo pockets bright discoveries and trusts clever digging more than brute force.
k071: Whether he is digging through packed earth with a two-burst soil chop, collecting faceted gems with a celebratory hop, running past tumbling rocks, or bracing his shoulder to push heavy boulders into a trap, Milo brings every cave to life.
k072: ⛏️ Digging Earth 💎 Collecting Gems 🏃 Running Paths 🪨 Pushing Boulders 🏊 Swimming Flooded Caves 🎉 Victory Celebrations
k073: Featuring Gemrift's official Milo Coppercap character art, procedural animation rig, and live in-game captures.
k075: Friends to outsmart. Foes to turn into treasure.
k076: Every creature in Gemrift follows deterministic rules you can read at a glance—and many reward a well-timed boulder drop with a shower of bonus gems.
k079: Armored in a spiked dark shell with a pulsing ember core. It hugs the left wall of any passage and detonates in a fiery 3×3 blast on contact with Milo or a falling rock.
k083: Flutters along the right-hand wall on broad, gem-faceted violet and turquoise wings. Crush a Prism Moth beneath a falling boulder to crystallize the blast into collectible gems!
k084: 💎 Drops a 3×3 cluster of gems when crushed
k087: Green amoeba colonies slowly spread through open tiles—hem them in with boulders so they suffocate and crystallize into gems! Or drop stones through purple Magic Walls to transmute rock into treasure.
k088: 🧪 Enclose amoebas to transform them into gems
k091: In flooded subterranean caverns, sinuous blue Lantern Eels sweep the dark with bioluminescent lures while diamond-winged Prism Rays glide by carrying pink dorsal gems.
k095: Coral-hued Octopuses curl eight tapering arms along left-hand cavern walls, while streamlined blue Reef Sharks patrol right-hand currents and burst into gems when crushed.
k096: 🦈 Crush Reef Sharks with boulders for bonus gems
k099: Frost-cavern guardians with distinct patrol axes: heavy Polar Bears pace horizontally back and forth across icy corridors, while striped Snow Tigers prowl vertical shafts and drop gems when defeated.

k160: Gemrift Privacy Policy — how Gemrift handles local save data, Microsoft Store licensing, and your privacy.
k164: Effective Date: March 2026 • Publisher: Bulent Ozkir • App ID: 9NV32H65BHMP
k165: Gemrift ("we", "our", or "us") is a Windows puzzle-action cave adventure developed and published by Bulent Ozkir. We respect your privacy and designed both this website and the Gemrift desktop game so you can play without surrendering personal data.
k167: No Personal Data Collection: Neither the Gemrift game nor this website collects, sells, rents, or transmits personally identifiable information (such as your name, email address, phone number, contacts, or precise location).
k168: No Accounts or Tracking SDKs: Gemrift does not require user registration, login credentials, third-party analytics trackers, or advertising cookies.
k169: 2. Local Game Data on Your Device
k170: Gemrift stores your game settings, unlocked caves, difficulty selections, and high scores locally on your Windows PC under your user profile (%APPDATA%\Gemrift\save.json). When you watch built-in cave solution recordings ("Show me resolution"), the game streams the MP4 walkthrough over HTTPS and caches it locally in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Gemrift\ RecordingsCache so subsequent views play offline. You can delete these local files at any time by uninstalling the app or clearing the folders.
k172: Gemrift is distributed via the Microsoft Store (ms-windows-store://pdp/?productid=9NV32H65BHMP&cid=PCCongratsBnr) with a 1-day free trial and a paid full version unlocking the complete 215-cave campaign and all solution videos. Billing, trial status verification, and license management are handled directly by Microsoft through the Windows Store APIs. Microsoft's own Privacy Statement governs transactions and Store telemetry.
k174: This website is hosted statically on GitHub Pages. We do not set tracking cookies or run analytics scripts. Standard web server logs (such as IP addresses requested for security and content delivery) are processed by GitHub in accordance with the GitHub Privacy Statement.
k176: Gemrift is a family-friendly cave puzzle adventure featuring Milo Coppercap. Because the game and website do not collect personal data from any user, we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13.
k178: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out via the Gemrift GitHub repository.
